title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12560)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard deals with internal corrosion of water boxes and its cathodic protection which can also extend the protective current to tube plates and tubes. 1.2 The scope of this standard is limited to the requirements for corrosion protection against corrosive cooling water possessing not more than 1 000 ohm. cm resistivity.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
